groups.distinction: Native Args/SerDeArgs model encoded reducer/view argument products; function kind, typed context and dispatcher distinguish reducer/caller-specific/anonymous authority. Marker records and generated FnInfo handle have actual generic registration/schema purpose, not pass-through game wrappers.
groups.uses: Reducer invokes a typed result then IntoReducerResult formats only at native Result<(),Box<str>> endpoint; errno/sink are explicit ABI. ViewReturn encodes Vec/Option as rowdata or RawQuery header, preserving caller/anonymous view dispatch. Native Typed ReducerArg/ContextArg and generated FnInfo enforce signatures, not semantic correlation between independently valid game args.
groups.disposition: Keep meaningful application error and argument owners internally; reducer Display wire support does not require String throughout domain helpers. Native tuple products and raw ID words are required ABI adapters; do not propose enum per numeric function index or duplicate framework context. Public wrapper types can earn their place through authority/unit even absent extra bounds; actual game constructors need own11 source.
groups.acceptance: Trace application typed errors/IDs/context to final native reducer boundary and actual client receiver. Preserve error formatting/protocol only there, without compatibility dual paths in application. Native ABI compatibility comments are external evidence, no permission to editSDK. View panic behavior and reducer result behavior differ; no runtime rollback/execution proof or generated client source edits.

limits: Exact pinned registered ranges personally read for11; no other-lens source credit, source edits, tests/checks, native execution, clearance or implementation plan.
